notes.title: v1.4 Major update!
notes.notes:
Biographies and other databases optimization.
Game tutorial optimization.
Units support optimization.
Since the first chapter, a large number of NPCS and new dialogue, events, and content can be freely explored.
Each level has added mission suggestions for the level, which are additional tips that are different from the tutorial.
When the items are full, you will get new items, and will be prompted to throw one of them away. Important items cannot be thrown away, and the warehouse character can choose to put them in the warehouse.
During the attack preparation phase, a confirmation window is displayed when you press the space bar to quickly attack.
Our character's head turns red and flashes when HP minimal.
Fixed a bug where the terrain of the mission target location became flat.
Limit Wood's ability to pick up items at will on Mount Gilead, and avoid a bug later in the Battle of Hogback where he can't automatically get weapons and ammo because he's full of scavenged items.
History message, which in some cases predisplays the following short piece of content has been fixed.
The first episode of Mr. And Mrs. Wood's arrival at Hogback Hill was reworked to avoid the previous misalignment.
There are other optimizations.

ps: The version number of the start game main menu still shows v1.3.2.1, you can check whether the update has been downloaded by looking at the main menu layout and the new database option.

Torian

notes.title: v1.3 Major update!
notes.notes:
This update will continue the content of v1.2, a comprehensive variety of ammunition, all characters initially carried, available, shop ammunition all reworked, which will further increase the supply and combat strategy!

New features for other weapons are also being redesigned to take into account the new counter-attack features added to the revolver.
The counterattack characteristics of the revolver are indeed very powerful, and you should think twice before you encounter any enemy armed with a revolver, so in addition to the range to avoid counterattack, there are other weapons that can suppress the revolver?
This time, the original design of the double-barreled shotgun increased the suppression effect of the revolver, which could avoid the counterattack of the revolver. Due to the characteristics of long-range rifles, revolvers and double-barreled shotguns, they form a restraint relationship between them, and this restraint relationship is included in other more abundant weapon types, greatly enriching the supply and combat strategy.
We can now declare a new level of balance of weapons, no longer a single long range rifle, but each weapon has its own advantages. Since each weapon has a corresponding type of ammunition, and ammunition supplies are limited, this prevents players from only stockpiling a certain type of gun (or only stockpiling a long range rifle).
However, even without supply constraints, just buying a long-range rifle is no longer the best option. In order to deal with the enemy who may be equipped with a variety of weapons, we must also enrich the types of weapons in the warehouse!

Next update preview: Big Map Travel and new elements in travel

This time, there will be a complete overhaul of the big map system, which will involve a lot of different areas of work, the most obvious being hand-drawn new big maps. Before simplified the big map part, after all, the big map is more or less independent of the main plot and combat system, the priority is not so high, so it is not detailed, this time finished the other parts, finally can do a good job of this part.

Torian

notes.title: Release Date set to Fourth of July
notes.notes:
Tired of boring war games on the sand table, crazy shooting games, rubbish of cheesy plots, and the stinking lies repeated by "lost causes"?   The art world needs a revolution!

The Heroic Legend of America: Second Revolutionary War is the first Abolitionist as the protagonist of the work, but also the first to fully present this history of the work, I hope you discover those unknown historical details and truths in this game, and get the enjoyment of reading classic novels!  

You will meet many fascinating characters and lead them through the mists of history to fight for the noble cause of humanity!

I sincerely invite you to join this great revolution.

Torian
